annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministers and High Authorities, Second Ministerial Summit on the Ethics of AI in Latin America and the Caribbean (hosted by AGESIC Uruguay, UNESCO, CAF)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ministerial declaration from the Second Summit on AI Ethics in Latin America and the Caribbean (Montevideo, Oct 2024) approving a regional roadmap on AI governance with priority areas, consolidating a permanent Working Group and annual summits, with UNESCO and CAF as technical support.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves a regional AI Roadmap with priority areas: governance and regulation, talent and work, vulnerable groups, environment, infrastructure
Consolidates the Working Group on AI Ethics in LAC; Uruguay takes over leadership from Chile
Establishes annual ministerial summits to follow roadmap implementation
Endorses UNESCO Readiness Assessment Methodology and CAF practical guide
Affirms human-rights-based, human-centred AI while respecting national sovereignty over policy
annotation.title_clean: Declaración de Montevideo: Para la construcción de un enfoque regional sobre la gobernanza de la Inteligencia Artificial y sus impactos en nuestra sociedad
annotation.title_en: Montevideo Declaration: Towards a Regional Approach to the Governance of Artificial Intelligence and Its Impacts on Our Society
